svg.text: A COURSE IS OPEN ON ONE TASK
Type a task the way you say it out loud
SHORTCUTS · THEY DO NOTHING THE THREE ROWS ABOVE CANNOT DO ONE CONTROL AT A TIME
WHY ACCEPT IS NOT THE EASY PATH
— Each row carries its own Accept, Edit and Reject.
— Acting on one control never touches the other two.
— Punch all and Strike all sit below the table, as shortcuts.
— Reaching Reject on a control costs the same click as Accept.
— A task with any control open stays visibly pending.
